V.''', commonly known as '''VfL Wolfsburg''' ({{IPA|de|ˌfaʊ ʔɛf ʔɛl ˈvɔlfsbʊɐ̯k|pron}}), is a German professional [[sports club]] based in [[Wolfsburg]], Lower Saxony. The club grew out of a multi-sports club for [[Volkswagen worker organizations|Volkswagen workers]] in the city of Wolfsburg. It is best known for its [[association football|football]] department, but other departments include [[badminton]], [[handball]] and [[Athletics (sport)|athletics]]. The men’s team plays in the [[2. Bundesliga]]. Wolfsburg have won the Bundesliga once in their history, in the [[2008–09 Bundesliga|2008–09]] season, the [[DFB-Pokal]] in [[2015 DFB-Pokal Final|2015]] and the [[DFL-Supercup]] in [[2015 DFL-Supercup|2015]]. Professional football is run by the spin-off organization ''VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH'', a wholly owned subsidiary of the [[Volkswagen Group]].{{cite web|url=http://annualreport2009.volkswagenag.com/additionalinformation/chronicle2009.html|title=Volkswagen Group Annual Report 2009|date=23 May 2009|access-date=17 August 2010|archive-date=31 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180331212836/http://annualreport2009.volkswagenag.com/additionalinformation/chronicle2009.html|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=http://www.vfl-wolfsburg.de/intern-leistungszentrum0.html|title=VfL Wolfsburg Club History|access-date=17 August 2010|archive-date=27 September 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927184912/http://www.vfl-wolfsburg.de/intern-leistungszentrum0.html|url-status=live}} Since 2002, Wolfsburg's stadium has been the [[Volkswagen Arena]]."}}
